description: The plot illustrates the "Hidden State Mean" across different layers, comparing three different hidden state metrics. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 23, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 4.5, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 1. The "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71" is represented by a blue dashed line without markers. It begins at approximately 0.0 at layer 0, maintains a relatively steady, low value between 0.2 and 0.5 up to layer 17, and then exhibits a sharp upward trend, reaching approximately 0.9 at layer 19, jumping to 2.6 at layer 21, and ending at a peak of approximately 4.3 at layer 23. The "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05" is shown as an orange dotted line without markers. It starts at approximately 0.0 at layer 0 and remains nearly flat, showing only a very slight, steady increase to end at approximately 0.1 at layer 23. Finally, the "hidden state" is depicted by a green solid line without markers. Similar to the orange line, it begins at approximately 0.0 at layer 0 and remains nearly flat across the x-axis, ending at approximately 0.1 at layer 23.
